claims.originating_goal: Publish the existing Admissibility, StegGuardian, and StegTalk wiki surfaces through their branded stegverse.org hostnames and propagate those canonical public links into Site as a lightweight navigation/bridge surface without duplicating wiki content or authority.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head validation, merge, and direct public observation of the branded wiki directory and links.
expected_evidence: Site wikis.html exposes Admissibility, StegGuardian, and StegTalk branded public URLs
Site wiki registry and Ecosystem Chat navigation use branded wiki origins
no duplicate wiki publication source or authority surface is created
collision_boundaries: Do not modify Site CNAME away from stegverse.org
Do not change Site GitHub Pages custom domain away from stegverse.org
Do not create duplicate wiki content on Site
Do not create a new runtime, authority plane, custody store, issue, branch, or COSV
claims.next_task_after_release: None for Site wiki publication unless a later branded wiki surface is added.
